subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】tomato 西红柿; potato 土豆; carrot 胡萝卜; green beans 四季豆; onion 洋葱; cow 奶牛; horse 马; hen 母鸡; sheep 绵羊
【重点句型】What are these/those? 这些/那些是什么？ They're ... 它们是…… Are they ...? 它们是……吗？ Yes, they are. / No, they aren't. 是的。/ 不是。 They're so big! 它们好大！
【A Let's talk】Mike: Look at the green beans. They're so long! Sarah: Yes, and the tomatoes are big. Farmer: The potatoes are big, too. Mike: Are they horses? Farmer: No, they're donkeys.
【Read and write】This is a farm. We have tomatoes, potatoes, carrots and green beans. The tomatoes are red. The carrots are orange. We have cows, horses, hens and sheep. The sheep are white. I like the farm.
key_points: What are these/those? 这些/那些是什么？
Yes, they are. / No, they aren't. 是的。/ 不是。
They're so big! 它们好大！
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
